Southgate. The Sept 3, 2025 outage thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes beside door 4. Pree's closing message says Southgate cleared the backlog and labels printed again. The thread doesn't give a street address or site code, so check the account record if the call needs one.
